user.title: Select your language
user.description: Choose the language for Telegram Menu. This first step is always shown in English.

connection_de.title: Telegram Menu – Telegram connection
connection_de.description: Select the existing Telegram bot and enter the chat ID. Menus and buttons are configured afterwards in the graphical editor.

data_description.notify_entity: Select the existing notify.telegram_bot_* entity from your Home Assistant Telegram integration.
data_description.chat_id: Telegram chat ID to which the menu should be sent.
